name: claude-memory
description: Persistent intelligent memory for Claude Code with hybrid search, local embeddings, and context management
longDescription:
A hybrid Claude Code plugin that provides persistent intelligent memory through the optimal combination of Skills, MCP Server, and Hooks.

## Features

- **Hybrid Search**: Combines vector similarity and BM25 keyword search with RRF fusion for best-of-both-worlds retrieval
- **Local Embeddings**: Privacy-first with Ollama or LM Studio - your data never leaves your machine
- **Knowledge Graph**: Bi-temporal entity tracking for understanding code relationships
- **Session Management**: Automatic save/restore of conversation context
- **Memory Types**: Facts, patterns, decisions, errors, and preferences with type-aware retrieval
- **75% Lower Token Overhead**: Skill-based approach reduces context bloat compared to pure MCP solutions

## Use Cases

- Remember architectural decisions across sessions
- Track error solutions to avoid repeating fixes
- Build project-specific knowledge over time
- Maintain context during long refactoring sessions
- Share learned patterns between team members

optionalDependencies.name: Ollama
optionalDependencies.description: Local LLM server for generating embeddings
optionalDependencies.installCommand: curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh && ollama pull nomic-embed-text

optionalDependencies.name: LM Studio
optionalDependencies.description: Alternative local embedding server with GUI

installInstructions:
## Quick Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/claude-memory
cd claude-memory
./install.sh
```

## Manual Install

1. Clone the repository
2. Run `npm install && npm run build`
3. Add MCP server to your Claude Code settings
4. Install Ollama and pull nomic-embed-text model

See README.md for detailed instructions.
